purpose.zh: 专练膝盖最后伸直的那一下
purpose.en: Train the last bit of straightening your knee.

text.zh: 把膝盖用力伸直，大腿前侧绷紧
text.en: Straighten your knee hard and tighten the front of your thigh

text.zh: 弹力带套在膝盖后面，膝盖微弯开始。
text.en: Loop the band behind your knee and start with a slight bend.

text.zh: 伸直后停两秒，脚跟不离地。
text.en: Hold straight for two seconds without lifting your heel.

commonErrors.zh: 只把髋往前顶，膝盖没伸直
commonErrors.en: Pushing your hips forward without fully straightening the knee.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼时换更轻的弹力带，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knee hurts, use a lighter band, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 改名：「终末伸膝」是术语 → 弹力带锁直膝盖 / Band Knee Lockout
口令「锁直膝盖」→「伸直」、「慢慢放松」→「放松」，适配 0.8/0.9 s 相位
flags: 改名：弹力带终末伸膝 → 弹力带锁直膝盖
